points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({ flavour, props, metadata, toModel })` ... `flavour` is a namespaced string such as `'affine:note'`. ... `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (e.g. `'hub'`)
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (e.g. `'hub'`) and the `parent` and `children` flavour constraints. These can use group aliases like `'@root'` and `'@content'`.
`toModel: () => new NoteBlockModel()` creates the model instance. The model class extends `BlockModel`

The component is a Lit element extending `BlockComponent<Model>` ... `this.renderChildren(this.model)` renders child blocks. ... `BlockViewExtension(flavour, literal\`affine-note\`)` maps a flavour to a static Lit tag.
`setup(context)` calls `context.register([...])` with: `BlockViewExtension`, `FlavourExtension(flavour)`, keymap, slash-menu, toolbar and clipboard configs, widgets

The schema extension is registered on the store side. The usual vehicle is a `StoreExtensionProvider` ... A `ViewExtensionProvider` subclass bundles these registrations ... A `ViewExtensionManager` ... takes the list of providers.
`effect()` runs the element registrations, e.g. `effects()`. ... `this.isEdgeless(context.scope)` lets it register a different view for page mode and edgeless mode.
